run_hydra_app: run the Hydra CLI app that prints the configuration as YAML output
create_hydra_main_app: create a Python app decorated with hydra.main that prints config as YAML
run_app_with_config: run the my_app function to print the Hydra DictConfig as YAML
create_simple_cli: create a simple CLI app using Hydra that outputs configuration in YAML format
run_omegaconf_yaml: run the app to convert an OmegaConf DictConfig to YAML and print it
